preconditions: a2 must be a non-null, non-empty, NUL-terminated MAS filename (null or empty first byte returns 0 immediately).
a1 may be null; it is only dereferenced on the Cubemas410 success path when non-null.
Registered path-prefix globals dword_8B8E30 (count) and byte_8B5A3C (array, stride 132) are read when the direct open fails.
postconditions: Returns 0 on Cubemas410 parse success and on a 12-byte header matching no recognized magic.
Returns -2 when the file cannot be opened (direct or via any registered prefix) or when the Cubemas410 parse returns -2.
Returns -1 when the Cubemas410 parse returns -1 or when the header is a recognized-but-incorrect MAS magic.
On Cubemas410 success with non-null a1, *a1 receives the created object pointer (or 0 if allocation/init failed).
On Cubemas410 success, the created object is appended to the global list rooted at dword_8B8F14 (or becomes the new head) and dword_8B6AC0 is incremented.
side_effects: Opens the uppercased filename for binary read ('rb') directly or retried across the registered path-prefix array; reads the 12-byte header and closes the handle.
On Cubemas410 header: allocates a 308-byte object, initializes it via sub_55FBE0, and parses the file via sub_55FC40.
On Cubemas410 parse success: links the object into the global singly linked list rooted at dword_8B8F14 (next pointer at +0x130, back pointer at +0x12C) and increments dword_8B6AC0.
On Cubemas410 parse failure (-1/-2): if the object exists, calls EmptyStub_7470 then FreeWrapper_7bcf to release it.
Reports fatal open/format errors via sub_53C590(-2, message).

lifecycle.owner: global MAS object list head dword_8B8F14

The name overstates the cube-map-only role.
